scoping.note: SCOPED, NOT ABSENT. The surah-scope fallback inventory covers every root in the surah; it is narrowed here to roots this ayah can justify -- roots occurring in this ayah (all their branches kept, unconditionally, because Layer 2 selects nothing) plus roots explicitly cited by channel material anchored here (only the cited branches kept, enough to resolve the citation). A root listed in dropped_roots is a deliberate scoping decision, not a missing source.

channel_review.note: first-pass blind review by a single reader; no adjudication, no accept/reject, no per-ayah channel maturity. Not a channel ledger.

branch_policy.note: No branch filtering is applied. Every branch present in each included dictionary/gloss root entry is kept.

root_lexicon.note: Turkish is the only language with dictionary entries/glosses currently sourced.

occurrence_evidence_trim.note: TRIMMED, NOT ABSENT. dictionary_entry.occurrence_evidence.occurrences and .ayahs are removed from every root by design: they are a per-occurrence QAC concordance and character-span alignment table carrying zero readings, branches or senses, and they dominated bundle size (~1.5 MB for a single common root). occurrence_evidence.summary (corpus frequency) and .forms (inflectional inventory) are retained. Dictionary/gloss branches are kept in full for every included Furuq root target.

root_mapping.policy: Use the dominant Furuq root for every QAC root, and include non-dominant Furuq targets as additional root_lexicon entries when qac-furuq-v4-root-map marks the QAC root as split.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlığa tapınma eylemini ve kişinin kendini tapınmaya vermesini anlatır. Türemiş kullanımlarda bir varlığı tapınılır kılmayı, tapınılan varlığı ve tapınma konusu sayılan varlıkları da adlandırır.

facets.statement: Temel eylem, bir varlığa tapınmak ve kişinin kendini bu tapınmaya vermesidir.
Eylemden türeyen varlık anlamı, kendisine tapınılan varlığı veya tapınma konusu sayılan nesneyi gösterir.
Ettirgen kullanım, bir varlığı başkalarınca tapınılır duruma getirme veya öyle sunma işlemini bildirir.
Güneşe kimi topluluklarca tapınılması nedeniyle ona tapınılan varlık anlamındaki bir ad verilmesi, varlık anlamının tarihsel bir örneğidir.

facets.statement: Dalın merkezinde, Yaratıcıyı başkalarından ayırarak gösteren ve yalnız ona özgü sayılan özel ad bulunur.

Özel adın doğrudan ya da seslenme öğesi yerine geçen bir sonla kullanılması, yakarma ve dilek bildiren seslenme biçimleri kurar.
Ses veya parçaların düşürüldüğü kısalmış biçimler, şaşma ve ant anlatan kalıplarda kullanılır.

concept_map.definition: Bir başkasına karşı yüreğin yumuşaması, ona acıma ve bu yönelişin onu esirgeyip ona iyilik etmeyi gerektirmesidir. Tanrı'ya uygulandığında insandaki duygulanmadan çok, kuşatıcı esirgeme ve iyilik sonucu öne çıkar.

facets.statement: Bir başkasının durumu karşısında yüreğin yumuşaması, ona acıma ve içten yakınlık duyma çekirdeği oluşturur.
Bu iç yöneliş, acınan kişiyi esirgemeyi ve ona iyilikte bulunmayı gerektiren etkin bir sonuç taşır.
Topluluğun bireylerinin birbirine acıyıp birbirini esirgemesi, çekirdeğin karşılıklı bir kuruluşta gerçekleşmesidir.
Bir kimsenin Tanrı'nın esirgemesine erişmesini dilemek, çekirdek anlamdan doğan kalıplaşmış bir söz eylemidir.
Tanrı hakkında kullanıldığında esirgemenin genişliği ve yaratılmışlara iyilik olarak ulaşması belirginleşir.

concept_map.definition: İnsanları ortak bir soydan gelmeleri yoluyla birbirine bağlayan yakın ilişkidir. Organ adı, birden çok kişinin aynı doğum kaynağından çıkması düşüncesiyle bu toplumsal bağa aktarılmıştır.

facets.statement: Ortak soydan gelme, kişiler arasında yakın ve kalıcı bir soy ilişkisi kurar.
Bedensel organın adı, aynı doğum kaynağından çıkmış olma düşüncesi üzerinden soy ilişkisine aktarılmıştır.
Soy bağını sürdürmek veya koparmak, ilişkinin kendisini değil ona karşı takınılan eylemli tutumu anlatır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İlişkinin ortak soy temelini açıkça belirtmenin tek sözcüklü karşılıktan daha önemli olduğu bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Ortak soy temelini, tarafları ve ilişkinin yakınlık niteliğini açıkça korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yakın soy ilişkisine karşı gösterilen bağlılık veya ilişkiyi kesme eylemi açıkça söz konusu olduğunda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bağın varlığını ve ona yönelik sürdürme ya da koparma eylemini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.text: soy bağını sürdürmek ya da koparmak

identity_judgment.rationale: Yetkili kaynak anlatımı, ortak soydan gelmeye dayanan yakın ilişkiyi dalın çekirdeği olarak verir ve organ adının ortak doğum kaynağı düşüncesiyle bu ilişkiye aktarıldığını açıklar. Hazırlanan çerçeve, bedensel organı bu daldan ayırırken soy bağını, çoğul bağları ve bu bağın sürdürülüp koparılmasını doğru yerde tutar.

text.arabic_uthmani: أَفَلَا يَتُوبُونَ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَهُۥ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ

baseline.text: Hâlâ Allah'a tövbe edip ondan bağışlanma dilemeyecekler mi? Allah çok bağışlayıcıdır, merhametlidir.

findings.text: Tehdit edilen temas, tövbe ve bağışlanmanın koruyucu örtüsüyle hâlâ kesilebilir.

activation_trace.role: The solicited-turn branch makes the rhetorical question an offered opening that calls for an answering return.
The worship branch identifies the destination and repeated divine subject as the one to whom allegiance and petition are redirected.
The moral-covering branch turns the second verb into an explicit request that the returned relationship deal with the fault and its effect.

changed_reading.after: Repentance is an answering movement toward God that becomes concrete by addressing the same God for protection from the fault's effect.
changed_reading.before: Repentance is simply feeling regret and asking for pardon.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired constructions يَتُوبُونَ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ and يَسْتَغْفِرُونَهُ direct both the turn and the request toward God.
baseline_models.mechanism: The interrogative solicits a response, the preposition gives that response a destination, and the attached object pronoun makes the same destination the addressee of the request. Repentance is therefore a relational movement completed as petition, not an undirected change of mood.

activation_trace.role: The physical-cover branch contributes a layer that both hides and preserves, giving forgiveness a protective material logic.
The fault-covering branch specifies that the protection concerns sin and the damaging consequence that follows it.
Tender mercy supplies the affective force by which the protective covering serves the person rather than merely hiding evidence.

changed_reading.after: The returning person asks to be covered and preserved from an exposed fault by a divine disposition explicitly characterized as tender mercy.
changed_reading.before: Forgiveness is a legal cancellation appended to repentance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The root غ ف ر occurs first as their requested action and then as God's standing predicate, followed by رَّحِيمٌ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The requested covering is answered by a predicate of abundant covering capacity. Its material branch adds preservation as well as concealment, while the mercy predicate prevents that cover from reading as mere suppression: it is tender protection of the exposed wrongdoer.

activation_trace.role: The loss branch supplies the terminal trajectory from which the invited turn withdraws.
The restored-course branch supplies the contrasting outcome of steadiness, readiness, and continuity after the turn.

changed_reading.after: The turn may also mark a change of viability: departure from a self-consuming course into one that can stand, continue, and become clear.
changed_reading.before: Turning describes only a change of direction.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The packet maps يَتُوبُونَ not only to ت و ب but also to the split target ت ب ب.
baseline_models.mechanism: The split inventory places loss and destruction beside the restoration of a prepared, straight, continuing course. Carried cautiously, the focus turn can be modeled as a reversal from a trajectory that wastes itself into one that becomes viable and steady.

activation_trace.role: Protective covering at the focus becomes the destination of a reversal in how covering is used.
Expiatory covering supplies the nearby positive model in which bad deeds, rather than truth, are what get covered over.
Truth-blocking covering supplies the failed defensive posture that the focus invitation asks the hearers to reverse.

changed_reading.after: Seeking forgiveness means stopping the concealment of truth so that an admitted fault, rather than truth itself, can receive protective covering.
changed_reading.before: Seeking forgiveness means asking for a fault to be hidden.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context supplies opposed uses of covering. One cover blocks truth; another removes bad deeds by covering them. The focus request for غفر then reverses both agent and object: the person relinquishes concealment of truth and seeks God's protective concealment of an acknowledged fault.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three cover-images; I infer a reversal from self-protective concealment to disclosed fault under divine protection. A live alternative is that the roots merely carry independent conventional senses without a designed material reversal.
structural_cues: 5:65 promises expiatory covering, 5:73 indicts truth-concealment, and 5:74 immediately offers a request for a different covering.

activation_trace.role: The preserving cover supplies the barrier sought at the open threshold before harmful contact.
Cessation and restraint define the first side of the threshold that repentance must cross.
The arrival of an effect by contact defines the threatened second side that protective forgiveness can intercept.

changed_reading.after: The ayah opens a last interval in which cessation, return, and requested covering can prevent the threatened consequence from making contact.
changed_reading.before: Forgiveness repairs damage after punishment has become due.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding ayah sets a threshold: cease the saying, or painful consequence will make contact. The focus invitation occupies the interval between cessation and contact, so return plus protective covering reads as an available interception before the threatened effect lands.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cessation, threatened contact, and a covering request; I infer a temporal arrow in which the request can interrupt contact. Alternatively, 5:73 may state consequence and 5:74 mercy without inviting a material shield sequence.
structural_cues: The unfulfilled condition in 5:73 is followed directly by the interrogative invitation in 5:74 before the discourse resumes its argument.

activation_trace.role: The worship branch makes the named destination of return a redirection of allegiance, not merely a location.
Submissive worship supplies the positive orientation to God that the focus return resumes.
The same worship image, now questioned when directed elsewhere, identifies the practical misdirection being reversed.
Effective possession and disposal distinguish a capable object of dependence from one unable to alter harm or benefit.
Divine hearing makes the focus request an addressed and receivable petition rather than a ritual utterance into incapacity.
Uncovered knowledge supplies the addressee's access to the condition for which covering is requested.

changed_reading.after: Turning to God withdraws worship and dependency from incapable objects and readdresses both allegiance and the plea for cover to the one who can hear, know, and act.
changed_reading.before: Turning to God is a generic moral reorientation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to worship God and the later test of powerless objects specify what turning إِلَى ٱللَّهِ changes. The penitent redirects submission and need toward the only addressee presented as able to dispose of outcomes, hear the petition, and know its condition.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies worship, incapacity, hearing, and knowledge; I infer that repentance redirects dependency and petition to the uniquely responsive agent. A live alternative is that the focus calls for ethical retraction without making worship-address the governing mechanism.
structural_cues: 5:72 commands worship of God, 5:75 emphasizes creaturely dependence on food, and 5:76 contrasts powerless worship objects with God's hearing and knowledge.

activation_trace.role: The solicited turn at the focus becomes the open question to which the later receptive sequence can function as an enacted answer.
Loss of inward sight supplies one closed channel whose recurrence shows that an earlier reopening did not become durable.
Failure to listen supplies the paired closure that the later act of hearing reverses.
Hearing as understanding and response initiates the successful receptive sequence.
Easy abundant flow gives the inward recognition an involuntary outward passage through the eyes.
The tear and its channel make changed perception bodily visible rather than leaving it as an untestable claim.
Recognition by a discernible mark supplies the cognitive hinge between receiving the message and confessing belief.

changed_reading.after: The requested turn can be recognized as reopened hearing and discernment whose pressure becomes tears, confession, and a new communal trajectory.
changed_reading.before: Repentance is an invisible decision reported by the speaker.

context_deltas.mechanism: Before the focus, blindness and deafness recur even after a divine turning. After it, another response runs in the opposite order: hearing becomes recognition, recognition overfills the eyes with tears, and the overflow becomes declared belief. This stages repentance as recovered permeability to evidence, embodied and spoken rather than merely inward.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies mirrored closed and open sensory sequences; I infer that the later sequence performs the kind of return asked for in 5:74. The materially live alternative is that 5:71 and 5:83 concern different groups and are contrastive examples, not stages of one conversion process.
structural_cues: 5:71 has closure, divine turning, then repeated closure; 5:83 has hearing, recognition, tears, and confession; 5:84-85 continue into hope and accepted reward.

activation_trace.role: The destruction branch supplies the adverse endpoint associated with refusing the turn.
The stable-course branch supplies the viable endpoint made available by the turn.
Recompense as an action returning to its actor supplies the adverse framing pole before the focus.
The same returning-recompense image supplies the favorable pole after receptive confession.

changed_reading.after: Repentance becomes a hinge that reroutes the returning consequence, away from loss and toward a stable course whose action can return as favorable recompense.
changed_reading.before: Repentance changes only the actor's present stance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pericope places a bad recompense at 5:60 and a good recompense at 5:85. Between them, the focus split target contrasts destruction with a course made stable. The invited turn can therefore function as the hinge that changes what comes back to the actor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a split focus mapping and two recompense recurrences; I infer that repentance reroutes the outcome returning to the actor. The alternative is a loose rhetorical bracket, since ت و ب, its ت ب ب split, and ث و ب are form-distant and not one lexical branch.
structural_cues: 5:60 names a worse recompense, while 5:83-85 move from reception and confession to divine reward, bracketing 5:74 with opposed returned outcomes.

remaining_uncertainties: Whether 5:83-85 is intended as the enacted answer to 5:74 or as a contrast involving a separate subgroup.
How much weight the form-distant relation among ت و ب, the mapped ت ب ب target, and ث و ب can bear.
Whether the material-cover and re-enclosing-shelter models clarify the sequence or overextend branch analogies.
strongest_changes: Seeking forgiveness became a reversal of covering: stop hiding truth and receive protective cover over acknowledged fault.
The adjacency of cessation and threatened contact made 5:74 an interval for interception before consequence lands.
Turning to God became redirected worship and dependency toward the only capable, hearing, knowing addressee.
The later hearing-recognition-tears sequence supplied an embodied answer to the earlier relapse into blindness and deafness.
summary.what_was_special: The split ت و ب to ت ب ب mapping, together with opposed ث و ب recompenses, exposed a return-of-outcome hinge; the less expected relapse and womb branches of غ ف ر and ر ح م also supported contained medical and shelter analogies.

activation_trace.role: The wound-or-illness relapse branch makes forgiveness imaginable as protection against deterioration after an apparent recovery.
Repeated inward blindness supplies the relapse pattern after the intervening divine turn.
Repeated failure to listen confirms that the recovered condition can close again rather than remaining healed.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the plea also asks that a reopened moral-perceptual wound be kept from relapsing after the turn.
changed_reading.before: Forgiveness remits a completed past fault.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the medical relapse branch of غ ف ر rather than its ordinary moral branch. It remains anchored in the focus's repeated غ ف ر and in 5:71's explicit improvement-then-renewed-closure sequence. Downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory relapse analogy, never as the lexical meaning of forgiveness or as a diagnosis.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The request يَسْتَغْفِرُونَهُ and predicate غَفُورٌ repeat غ ف ر around a context that has already shown reopening followed by relapse.

activation_trace.role: The life-bearing enclosure supplies a contained image for mercy as a place of protected re-formation.
The preserving cover joins mercy to the spatial logic of being sheltered rather than left exposed.
Joining a gathering refuge supplies the adverse enclosure from which the focus invitation offers a change of destination.
Entry supplies the actual transition into a different containing community after recognition and belief.
The tree-covered garden supplies the favorable enclosure in which the redirected person is finally housed.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, mercy re-houses the returned person: from a destructive refuge into preserving cover, communal entry, and a life-bearing enclosure.
changed_reading.before: Mercy is a divine affect appended to the promise of forgiveness.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries the womb branch of ر ح م into a spatial sequence of refuge, entry, and covered garden. It remains anchored in رَّحِيمٌ and the focus's protective غ ف ر, while the context supplies opposed enclosures. Render it as a cross-domain image of re-housing under mercy, not as a claim that رَّحِيمٌ literally denotes a womb here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The protective cover of غ ف ر is immediately qualified by رَّحِيمٌ, whose inventory includes a life-bearing enclosure.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The threatened contact remains interruptible by protective covering.** `غ ف ر B001` is covering and `B002` shielding from consequence, joined to `ر ح م B001` tenderness. After 5:73's painful touch, I infer that return and seeking forgiveness insert a shield between formulation and consequence; warning remains an opening, not closure.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later ayah 5:120 made the fixed ayah's local distinctions newly visible as bounded operations within a single encompassing dominion, rather than as an isolated rule or episode.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **The threat remains adjacent to a route into shielding.** Fixed **غ ف ر / B001** (“protective covering”) and **B002** (“forgiving and shielding from consequence”) are requested and then restated as divine qualities. The prior two ayat announce barring and painful contact; the next ayat expose creaturely dependence and warn against excess. I infer from this immediate placement that correction is intended to move the addressees under protection before the threatened consequence closes upon them. The question reads as an open causal exit, not a tonal interruption of condemnation.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 5:75–5:76 showed what the open route asks them to acknowledge: creaturely dependence and lack of independent disposal, before 5:77 warns against desire-driven excess.

The fused particle stack makes the ayah arrive as a follow-up, while the sharp opening sound helps the rebuke feel like an interruption that asks why return has not followed.

Its independent particle shape lets the negation govern the coordinated verbal span, so the missing duty is a paired absence rather than only the first verb.

topics.reason: The attachment evidence coordinates the two verbs inside one rhetorical question, so the negator's scope over the pair is locally licensed.

words.prose: {{ar:يَتُوبُونَ}} ({{tr:yatūbūna}}) turns the particle pressure into a specific action: present, available reorientation rather than a completed past act or a bare imperative. Its Form I intransitive frame waits for {{ar:إِلَى ٱللَّهِ}} ({{tr:ilā allāhi}}), so repentance is heard as movement toward a terminus. The plural form keeps the group from 5:73 in view, and its -ūna cadence pairs with the next human-action verb before the ayah shifts into the nominal attribute answer. The same Surah 5 return-thread, including 5:39 and 5:71, makes this polemical moment part of a wider invitation pattern.
